about_the_game:
Take a load off your mind with Built to Scale Solitaire, a uniquely designed card game about building a musical scale, inspired by Zachtronics' solitaire games.

  • ASSEMBLE: Stack cards in ascending order by suit, but take care around the Widget cards which need to be assembled in a free cell!

  • BUILD SCALES: Each card sent to the foundation is part of a scale. Arrange your cards right and they'll all fall into place automatically.

  • TUNES TO SOLVE TO: Jam out to original music written by GenericArrangements! Warning: they're very catchy...

  • HD TEXTURES: Play with new, 4K-ready card textures, or switch back to classic textures at any time.

  • STATS & ACHIEVEMENTS: Track your best (and worst) games with built-in stats and earn Steam Achievements.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 or newer, 64-bit only
  • Processor: Intel i3 6th gen or newer; Ryzen 3 1st gen or newer
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 512 MB video memory or more, OpenGL 3.0+ support
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL 1.1+ support
  • Additional Notes: Minimum 1280x720 resolution required
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Additional Notes: 1920x1080 resolution or higher recommended
